title: SAP connection timeout
issue: SAP integration was failing with connection timeout errors.
solution: Increased connection timeout and adjusted retry configuration.
outcome: Partially worked. Timeouts were reduced but the issue returned during larger data loads.

title: Data synchronization failure
issue: Records were not consistently synchronizing from SAP to the data platform.
solution: Changed the synchronization process to use batch-based processing.

title: Dashboard refresh delay
issue: Acme reported that dashboards were taking too long to refresh.
solution: Optimized the data pipeline and reduced unnecessary processing during refresh.

title: Customer monitoring request
issue: Acme requested monitoring and alerts for SAP synchronization failures.
